tick_cost.note: a machine of this mod ticks as its donor does; the mod adds one repair record for each machine under repair and no map component that runs each tick

long_stall.note: read on the whole run and on map generation with the placement step

latency.note: the repair order and the study switch are the two clicks

memory.establishes: a heap read before and after the whole run (sc_whole_journey) establishes no growth across one journey of two machines with a save and a reload; flatness over 30 days stays inferred from the absence of any per-tick state (one repair record per machine under repair)

load_time.note: about 60 new ThingDefs and 40 research projects, and 137 new pictures; read on the small list

save_size.establishes: the save of the whole run against the starting save establishes what one journey adds; growth over a long colony stays inferred from one small record per machine

save_compat.note: check C_old_save: a save with working factory machines made without this mod loads with them standing and working. Removal of the mod from a save: every machine of this mod and every Ancient Component is lost with the usual missing-def messages, the factory mod's own machines return to the build menu, and the research projects of this mod are dropped; a removal test runs only when asked

load_order.note: loads after the factory mod and Harmony; names no hauler mod, no FlowWorks and no Research Reinvented as a requirement

mod_settings.note: bar switch_gives_machine_back; one on/off line for each machine, the level and cost numbers, the two placement switches, the riders' switches as built

art.note: each Wrecked and Kludged level has pictures of its own (rule R_whole_picture); the art judge reads each against the canon library

clickable.note: the factory machines are drawn over several cells; a click on the art of a wreck selects it

order_taken.note: the repair order and the study switch show at once that they were taken, before a colonist arrives (bar repair_on_the_machine: a repair mark and the list of missing materials)

motion.note: a change of level is a change of look: sc_repair_on_machine and sc_whole_journey capture before, during and after

worldgen.note: the mod places things on local maps only; it makes and changes no world

biome_scope.note: placement reads whether a ruin room or open ground exists and no biome; repair, study and the levels read the machine and its ground only

flight.evidence: the mod has no creature and no pawn: its ThingDefs are buildings and one item (src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Defs)

test_isolation.note: design/concepts/WreckedMachines/version/small_list.json; the cannery's checks need Vanilla Cooking Expanded on a tier of their own
